bio.text: Matthew Laszacs is the Libertarian Party candidate for North Carolina's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
He was the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina House District 41 in 2024, when incumbent Maria Cervania (D) won the seat.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as executive and a bachelor's degree from North Carolina Wesleyan College in 2009.
